about: The games this mashup joins: the host Melty installs into and starts, and the two games whose real content is read from the player's own installed copy.

role.about: primary = Melty installs into it and starts it; secondary = the mod finds it itself

installdir.about: expected folder under steamapps/common (the acf's installdir wins)

probe_file.about: relative path that proves this folder is the game

brings.about: what this game really brings into the mashup

missing_text.about: message shown in game when it is not installed

never.about: what the mashup must never do to this game

rows.name: Garry's Mod
rows.brings: The engine underneath (physics, rendering, input, sound), kept out of sight by the silentkatamari gamemode.
rows.never: Ship files another mashup also ships (conflicts); overwrite base files (gmod.exe, garrysmod_*.vpk).

rows.name: Once Upon A KATAMARI
rows.engine: Unity 6, IL2CPP, URP, Addressables bundles, CRIWARE audio
rows.brings: The objects you roll up (real meshes and textures), Katamari's rules (catch size, growth rate from its object table), its roll-up sounds and its size display.
rows.never: Launch it, inject into it, touch its online KatamariBall mode or saves, or ship any of its files.

rows.name: SILENT HILL 2
rows.engine: Unreal Engine 5.1, IoStore containers, Wwise audio
rows.brings: James Sunderland himself (his model, textures and animations) pushing the katamari, and the town's atmosphere: radio static, ambience and music.
rows.never: Launch it, patch or wrap its exe (it has a Steam DRM wrapper), decrypt it with a key from anywhere, or ship any of its files.
